text: [38] samaggaṃ pana bhante saṅghaṃ bhetvā 1 kiṃ so pasavatīti . kappaṭṭhiyaṃ 2 ānanda kibbisaṃ pasavatīti . kiṃ pana bhante kappaṭṭhiyaṃ kibbisanti . kappaṃ ānanda nirayamhi paccatīti . āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho saṅghabhedako vaggarato adhammaṭṭho yogakkhemato dhaṃsati saṅghaṃ samaggaṃ bhetvāna kappaṃ nirayamhi paccatīti .
